concepts.proposed_markdown: A separate organization layer groups legally related company accounts for one Customer Area login after Adyen-side setup. Membership does not grant access to every company by default, and roles remain distinct for each company account. This access layer does not itself define merchant-account processing, contracts, seller identity, or fund flow. [[source-adyen-docs-account-manage-account-structure-create-an-organization]]
